source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 10 iulie — «Sfântul Ierarh Gheorghe, episcopul Tesalonicului»

attestations.note: His page says in as many words that no synaxarion knows his commemoration — «Pomenirea lui este necunoscută sinaxarelor» — and that he is honoured with the Vatopedi saints on 10 iulie. So the Romanian day is a house commemoration of the Holy Mountain, not an inherited one, and that is what this row records.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Γεώργιος Μητροπολίτης Θεσσαλονίκης ο Γλυκύς»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the see is the folder's own byname: the Romanian line reads «Sfântul Ierarh Gheorghe, episcopul Tesalonicului» and the Greek «Άγιος Γεώργιος Μητροπολίτης Θεσσαλονίκης ο Γλυκύς». That, and the day, settle him against the corpus's many other men named George. The Greek page adds the ground of the memory and its date: his name stands twenty-ninth in the Synodikon of Thessalonica, which puts his episcopate in the third decade of the eleventh century; «Η μνήμη του είναι άγνωστη στους συναξαριστές», he is honoured with the Vatopedi saints on 10 July, and he is also commemorated at the synaxis of all the saints of Thessalonica, which falls on the third Sunday of Matthew — a feast reckoned from Pascha that the schema cannot hold, and no second row is proposed for it. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn under his line.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
